# Isolation Forest stability (V3)

**SYNTHETIC DATA — stability of rankings on held-out synthetic days, not detection performance and not a real-world estimate (ADR-012).**

<!-- GENERATED by `uv run netanomaly stability`. -->

- Split: train 2026-09-01..2026-09-03 (3 days, 111,355 rows); scored 2026-09-04..2026-09-06 (3 days, 111,405 rows). Train fraction 0.5.
- Features (7): `flows`, `bytes_out`, `packets_out`, `uniq_dst_ip`, `uniq_dst_port`, `internal_ratio`, `max_flow_bytes`.
- Forest: 200 trees, max_samples 256. Labels used: no.
- Reference: mean anomaly_score of the seed-stability models (seeds 42–51, 111,355 training rows each).
- Agreement: Spearman rho over all scored rows; top-100 overlap = share of a day's top-100 host-windows shared with the other ranking (mean over scored days; worst single day separately). Cells: median (min–max) over seeds or pairs.
